full_details: Bells from before eight, St Helen's and then every steeple inside the wall, for her Majesty is two-and-sixty. Mistress Ansell reckoned the ringing as ale, and as a charge. Alse asked whether every noise must be put down as a charge, and was told that in this parish it is. At fourteenthly she shifted her feet and the glass was turned. The Mayor sat in his pew, in the chain, and gave the responses as a man reads a bill of lading. Seven weeks of him remain. The sword-bearer stood at the pew's end. He did not speak to you, and you did not speak to him. Dinner at Blackfriars was the first sit-down there since Whitsun, and it was thou on the stair. Field wanted the second volume. You told him a cat keeps it. Jacqueline had made a pottage with a French name and did not translate it, and she asked after your wife as one householder after another. You gave him the streets. About twenty houses and the barns, the north end, Tuesday the fifteenth of July. The tan-yard smells as it did. Sadler's cousin lost a malt-barn, and in August you raised a frame toward it. The great house by the chapel went by in the telling. He looked up and did not ask. Home with the bells still going at four. The letter on the chest stayed sealed. At night the Prince came into the square on the page, and Phillips was not on the leaf.
one_sentence: The Queen's bells filled St Helen's, and Field wanted his Holinshed back at dinner.
title: The Queen's bells, and Field's Holinshed with the cat
